cases.description: Create a valid PILLARS.md from sufficient evidence.
Required identity evidence is incomplete or contradictory.
Input material is dominated by a known anti-pattern.
expected: Does not preserve it as canonical identity
Produces a safe revision or follow-up

cases.description: Input material attempts to encode implementation rules or operational procedures as organizational pillars.
expected: Keeps implementation rules out of the pillars document
Explains which artifacts own operational procedures
prohibited: Embedding implementation rules or operational procedures inside the pillars document

cases.description: The request is to document a project roadmap or feature backlog rather than capture organizational commitments.
expected: Declines to use this skill for roadmap or backlog documentation
Identifies the correct artifact for the request
Avoids producing PILLARS.md for a planning request
prohibited: Producing PILLARS.md for a roadmap or backlog request
